deployments_detail.use: Bright Designer — web app using NVIDIA Omniverse simulation and robotic-automation insights (streamed on Microsoft Azure) to accelerate design of CPU/GPU server products for AI data-center infrastructure. Jabil named as a customer that will use it (private preview). [Bright Machines, NVIDIA (Omniverse), Microsoft Azure]
J-422G AI servers + rack-level AI data-center infrastructure (compute/storage/photonics/cooling)

Intelligent Shop Floor Assistant — a generative-AI chatbot giving manufacturing floor operators instant troubleshooting and diagnostic answers across 1,700+ policies, specs and knowledge articles in multiple languages. First iteration built in one week; launched and rolled out globally. [AWS (Amazon Q Business, Amazon Bedrock via Generative AI Innovation Center)]
deployments_detail.value: Built first iteration in 1 week; access to 1,700+ documents; reduced average troubleshooting time (no % disclosed)

deployments_detail.use: AI-augmented Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) — machine-vision pattern recognition layered onto AOI machines for product inspection and quality control, raising defect-detection accuracy from ~60-70% to as high as 97%. [none disclosed]
AI + data-analytics for injection-molding process control — analyzing injection pressure, speed and temperature parameters to detect common deviations and improve molding quality. [none disclosed]

Visual-inspection deep-learning pilot on production lines using Azure Machine Learning and Project Brainwave (FPGA-accelerated inferencing) to improve speed and accuracy of component inspection. [Microsoft (Azure Machine Learning, Project Brainwave)]

Arch Systems AI-guided action systems across Jabil's global factory network — building on prior SMT connectivity and advanced analytics, expanded to backend, assembly and test operations, with an agentic-AI roadmap. Jabil made an equity investment in Arch to fund deployment. [Arch Systems]

NVIDIA Omniverse 3D factory digital twin (with Deloitte) at the new Salisbury, North Carolina site — high-fidelity digital twin to virtually plan and simulate factory layouts for building liquid-cooled data center equipment before physical deployment. [NVIDIA (Omniverse), Deloitte]

AI-enabled low-power optical inspection system developed in Malaysia (a Deliver Best Practices competition winner) — consumes just 3-4 watts versus 10x+ for traditional inspection equipment, cutting energy use while performing quality inspection. [none disclosed]
deployments_detail.value: 3-4 watts vs at least 10x that for traditional equipment

deployments_detail.use: AI/robotics-guided quality-control robots — e.g., inspecting air-conditioning units to verify screws and labels are correctly installed, reducing waste and process-related emissions across Jabil facilities. [none disclosed]
Intelligent Procurement Assistant — generative-AI chatbot providing market intelligence on suppliers, pricing and product lifecycle data to support procurement decisions. [AWS (Amazon Q Business)]

Centralized data lake and analytics/ML platform — consolidated siloed machine data from 100+ plants on Amazon Redshift, enabling cross-domain analytics and ML-based inventory forecasting; foundation for GenAI tools. Included automating shop-floor application deployment (AWS CDK/Terraform) and moving Data Dispatcher to serverless AWS Glue Flex. [AWS (Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue Flex, EKS, AWS Professional Services)]
deployments_detail.value: 74% decrease in data processing times; 67-83% reduction in deployment times; 23% cost savings from serverless integration
